name: Compack USA
old_description: We're all about packaging, and it's our mission to make a positive difference in every packaging operation we visit.
about:
Compack USA was founded in 2013 by Doug Barter in Portland, Oregon. Barter brought his packaging knowledge and innovative ideas to the Pacific Northwest to establish the company.

Compack USA operates as a packaging supply distributor, offering a broad catalog that includes tapes and adhesives, stretch wrap, plastic and poly packaging, protective packaging, strapping equipment, boxes and cardboard, shipping and mailing supplies, and janitorial products. The company works with businesses across the United States to identify opportunities for improving packaging operations through high-quality products and tailored processes. Compack also provides complimentary packaging operation audits and consulting, along with free shipping on all orders and bulk corporate pricing. Headcount and facility size are not publicly disclosed.

The company serves warehousing, distribution, third-party logistics (3PL), e-commerce, fulfillment centers, and distribution centers throughout the United States, helping them improve packaging efficiency and reduce costs.

Founded to make a positive difference in packaging operations, Compack emphasizes reducing downtime, increasing productivity, and lowering packaging costs through tailored materials and dependable supply. The company highlights its combined industry experience of over 40 years as a foundation for its approach.
type_evidence: Compack USA is a packaging supply company comprising experienced industry professionals ready to use their expertise to help businesses achieve and surpass their goals.
